scope: Read-only census of preparation_failures.csv in the reference Alzheimer project, for triage decision C8 (2026-11-27).
method: Every preparation_failures.csv under the project was read; one row is one compound/receptor attempt, so rows exceed distinct compounds. Reasons were normalized by dropping paths and identifiers. No file was written in the project and no engine ran.

mol2_topology_or_atom_types.reason: ValueError: Topologia ou tipos atômicos MOL2 inválidos para o docking.

pdbqt_multiple_root_fragments.reason: ValueError: PDBQT contém múltiplos fragmentos ROOT incompatíveis com Vina

pdbqt_invalid_coordinates_charges_or_typ.reason: ValueError: PDBQT do ligante contém coordenadas, cargas ou tipos atômicos inválidos

conclusions.C8: Rewiring the Chimera charge repair would address 6 of 809 excluded compounds (<1%); it is not a priority. Rewiring or removing the dead code both remain acceptable.
conclusions.new_finding: The dominant exclusion cause is MOL2 topology/atom types (694 compounds). It is unrelated to C8 and deserves separate investigation, outside issue #6.
